card.name: Small words before a noun phrase
card.fires_on: Determiner-like words that sit right before a noun phrase: "even" in "accidental ingestion of even one dose", and possessives such as "body's", "your" and "their" before a describing word.

modes.label: "even" before a small amount
modes.description: The word "even" comes right before a minimal quantity such as one dose or a small crack.
modes.example: Accidental ingestion of<< even>> one dose of Levorphanol Tar

modes.label: Possessive before a descriptor
modes.description: A possessive ("'s", "your", "their") comes right before a descriptive word such as "most important", "natural" or "usual".
modes.example: your body<<'s>> most important defense against nasal infections

card.writes: It pushes toward words like "new", "newest", "latest" and "entire", which are modifiers that come before a noun, and away from hyphenated compounds.
card.plain: It fires on a small word like "even" or "your body's" that sits just before the main noun phrase is described.
